title: Content library
subtitle: Publish courses for academies to copy and customize.

create.heading: Create a library course
create.body: Create a draft, then publish it when it is ready for academies to copy.
create.description_placeholder: Variables, loops and functions across 12 modules

copies.heading: Academies using {{title}}
copies.body: See which academies copied this course, the version they copied, and whether they have edited it.

empty.heading: No master courses yet
empty.body: Create the first one. Once you publish it, every academy in the organization can take a copy.
empty.search_body: Try a different word, or clear the search to see the whole library.

unavailable.title: Could not load the library
unavailable.body: Refresh the page and try again.

edit.heading: Rename library course
edit.body: Academies that already copied it keep the name they chose.

import.description: Copy the course and its hidden content into a separate library draft. Student work and class assignments are excluded.
import.success: Copied to library as a draft.
import.origin: Copied from {{academy}} · {{course}} · revision {{revision}} on {{date}}. This is an independent copy.

blockers.ASSET_MISSING: Asset is missing or does not match its manifest

picker.description: Choose a course from any academy to copy into the library as an independent draft.

language.label: Course type
language.locked: The language is fixed once the course has problems.

PYTHON.title: Python
PYTHON.description: Python 3. Run and Test in the browser; Submit is graded on the server.

C_CPP.title: C / C++
C_CPP.description: GCC 12. Each problem is C or C++; Run, Test and Submit compile on the server.

WEB.title: Web
WEB.description: HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Students code in their own editor, so coding practice is not offered.

sync.heading: Library updates
sync.changes: {{changed}} changed · {{added}} added · {{removed}} removed, ready to publish
sync.no_changes: All saved changes have been published.
sync.copies_empty: No academy has adopted this course yet.
sync.batch_help: Save your changes across the course, then publish them together. Academies are notified only when their own edits need review.
sync.batch_published: Updates published. Academy copies will sync automatically.

legacy.title: Existing academy copies
legacy.description: Link old copies to published updates. Uncertain material identities are reviewed by academy editors; their content is preserved.
legacy.review: {{count}} library nodes will require identity review. Linking will not replace academy content.
